notes.title: Cards and Hats Update
notes.notes:
Hellooo, Mates!


 New Duel Mode! Hardcore mode challenges your aim and also gives you random cards with unique moves!
 New hats for the RubberDucks and many more hats are coming!
 New Gun, better game feel and also a better scenario post-processing for the 360Duel.


Everything looks much more polished; more skill-based gameplay and what really matters for you; more fun with friends ;)
